features.purpose: Compare lexical reply evidence with local semantic fusion after retrieval-corpus or embedding changes.
features.evidence_metric: Useful evidence sets found only by hybrid retrieval in completed live comparisons.
features.promotion_criteria: A fresh deterministic offline benchmark demonstrates source-grounded rescues without unacceptable hard-negative regressions.
features.retirement_criteria: The benchmark is superseded or no longer reproducible against the maintained research corpus.
features.reason_for_current_state: Fifty retained live comparisons produced zero hybrid-only evidence rescues; manual benchmarking preserves the experiment without recurring production cost.

features.purpose: Measure whether identity-dependent generated images would require cross-quotation penalties or exclusions.
features.evidence_metric: Policy-caused winner changes while generated images are eligible for production selection.
features.promotion_criteria: Generated pool activation is separately approved and deterministic shadow evidence shows safe, useful policy effects.
features.retirement_criteria: Generated images remain disabled permanently or the identity policy is replaced by a validated successor.
features.reason_for_current_state: The generated-image pool is disabled, so routine identity-policy shadow scoring cannot produce decision-relevant observations.

features.purpose: Observe materially misleading historical quotation-image relationships without changing production selection.
features.evidence_metric: Judged production winners, veto reasons, safe alternatives and production-selection invariant failures.
features.promotion_criteria: Separately authorised evaluation retains strict safety and coverage gates with zero production-selection invariant failures.
features.retirement_criteria: The manifest becomes stale, coverage falls below its gates or a validated successor replaces it.
features.reason_for_current_state: The corrected v3 manifest is loaded in non-enforcing shadow mode and continues to collect production-relevant relationship evidence.

features.purpose: Compare original-image editorial metadata adjustments with the production image winner.
features.evidence_metric: Shadow winner disagreements, score adjustments and editorial mismatch reasons.
features.promotion_criteria: A separately reviewed sample demonstrates consistent editorial improvement without selection or state side effects.
features.retirement_criteria: The scorer provides no useful disagreements or is replaced by a validated selector revision.
features.reason_for_current_state: The scorer remains observational and has produced useful comparative ranking evidence without affecting production.
